exposure: initial respiratory support modality (CPAP vs initial mechanical ventilation)
cohort: The study included 1560 preterm infants delivered at less than 32 weeks of gestation from multiple neonatal intensive care units in China.
finding: Continuous positive airway pressure failure was associated with an increased risk of mortality and major morbidities, including BPD, pulmonary haemorrhage, and pneumothorax, comparable to the risk associated with initial mechanical ventilation.
